meta.title: Middle Corridor Freight Monitor
meta.methodology_note: Latest published Xi’an–Ambarli/Mersin full-route freight assessment, in USD per loaded 40HC container. The median of comparable assessment midpoints is used; partial-route prices and modelled costs do not enter the index.
meta.data_warning: Historical coverage reflects the availability of published market assessments.

methodology_change.new_basis: Full-route freight price in USD per 40HC
methodology_change.previous_basis: 50/50 Baku–Türkiye market basket divided by the Baku structural cost reference × 100
methodology_change.comparability: The new price series is recalculated retrospectively; it must not be compared numerically with the previous index points.

model.name: MCFI-40 Full-Corridor Freight Rate
model.description: Latest published Xi’an–Ambarli/Mersin full-route freight assessment, in USD per loaded 40HC container. The median of comparable assessment midpoints is used; partial-route prices and modelled costs do not enter the index.

shipment.ownership: Market assessment; container ownership basis recorded where available
shipment.core_path: Xi’an (China) → Khorgos/Altynkol (Kazakhstan) → Aktau/Kuryk → Alat/Baku (Azerbaijan) → Georgia → Ambarli/Mersin (Türkiye)
shipment.pricing_basis: USD per 40HC, terminal-to-terminal market assessment; inclusions recorded source-by-source

routes.label: Xi’an (China) → Ambarli/Mersin (Türkiye)
routes.purpose: Complete westbound Middle Corridor benchmark route

model.formula: MCFI-40 (USD/40HC) = median of the midpoints of comparable Xi’an–Ambarli/Mersin market assessments.
model.route_quote_rule: Use the median of comparable full-route market-range midpoints for each month; show the published range (range envelope when more than one assessment is used).
source_hierarchy: Published carrier and forwarder tariffs for additional market reference
model.publication_rule: Publish only a documented full-route Xi’an–Ambarli/Mersin 40HC market assessment. Show its assessment period; retain the latest observed value when no newer assessment exists. Do not substitute partial-route, SOC provider or modelled prices.
model.methodological_anchor: Monthly full-route Xi’an–Ambarli/Mersin 40HC market assessments. Earlier months are reconstructed only where equivalent published full-route ranges are available.
model.index_formula: MCFI-40 = midpoint of full-route range; median of midpoints if multiple comparable assessments exist.
model.reference_note: Structural tariffs and the Xi’an–Baku cost model are contextual reference data only. They are not the base or denominator of MCFI-40.

theoretical_cost_model.route: Xi’an International Port → Horgos/Khorgos (China) → Altynkol / Khorgos Gateway (Kazakhstan) → Aktau Port → Port of Baku (Alat) → Absheron/Baku area

components.label: China rail linehaul
components.source_name: China Railway container tariff structure / documented Xi'an–Horgos rail distance
components.note: Route aligned with the Xi'an–Baku/Poti Middle Corridor service via Horgos/Khorgos. The tariff formula is a structural modelling rule, not an executable 2026 quote.

components.label: China border customs administration
components.method: Customs inspection/admin fee per container consignment

components.label: TITR structural block
components.note: Latest public official all-in structural anchor located. It is not represented as a current executable October 2026 quotation.

theoretical_cost_model.confidence_note: China linehaul/border items are modelled from public tariff rules and a documented 3,200 km Xi'an–Horgos rail distance; the central TITR block uses published official anchors. From April 2026 the last KTZ Express public rate is carried forward until a newer public all-in rate is located.

historical_cost_methodology.china_and_border: Held in native CNY structural terms and converted using the v1 reference FX in this first historical build; a later version may substitute monthly FX.

integrated_official_reference.effective_period: 2026 published schedule · maritime validity requires reconfirmation
integrated_official_reference.note: Partial-corridor references from Altynkol, not Xi’an. Group-shipment and exclusion conditions apply. The sheet states 2026 validity, but ASCO rates are stated valid only through 31 March 2026; current maritime pricing requires confirmation. These overlapping schedules must not be added to segment tariffs or the headline assessment.
